stem: A team runs a hybrid meeting with remote and in-person participants. Which practice best supports participants who are Deaf or hard of hearing?

options.text: Enable live captions and amplify remote audio into the room.
options.rationale: Live captions give real-time text access, and room audio lets everyone follow remote speakers.

options.text: Ask participants to wait for the chair to recognize them before speaking.
options.rationale: Turn-taking helps order but does not make the spoken content available.

options.text: Record the meeting and share the captioned video afterward.
options.rationale: A recording is useful later but does not make the live discussion accessible.

options.text: Use a single microphone at the front of the room.
options.rationale: One front microphone may not pick up audience questions or remote audio clearly.

explanation: Access has to work during the meeting. Live captions convert speech to text in real time, and the room sound system must carry remote participants so everyone can hear them. A recording shared later does not replace access during the meeting, and turn-taking alone does not make speech available to people who cannot hear it.
author: Oxypteros
